name: Sint Eustatius

flag.description: Four blue panels in the corners, each outlined in red, surround a white diamond in the center that holds a green silhouette of the island beneath a gold star.
flag.symbolism: Blue is the surrounding sea, red the flamboyant tree, green the island with its Quill volcano, white its legendary waterfall, and the gold star unity.

hook: Sint Eustatius puts a green map of the island inside its white diamond, where neighbouring Saba has only a star.
trivia: Designed by Zuwena Suares, the flag was adopted in 2004 and first flown on Statia Day, 16 November.
On 16 November 1776 the island's fort fired a salute to an American ship, one of the first foreign acknowledgements of the United States.
